patient_explanation: The hip joint has not developed in the usual way, which is being checked in infancy.
clinical_context: Common paediatric finding, screened for in infancy; treatable if caught early.
action_note: Early orthopaedic follow-up improves outcomes.

simple_meaning: One part of the bowel telescoping into another
patient_explanation: Part of the bowel has folded into an adjacent section, like a telescope, causing a blockage.
clinical_context: A common cause of bowel obstruction in young children; needs urgent treatment.
action_note: This requires urgent treatment.

simple_meaning: Thickened stomach outlet muscle in infants
patient_explanation: The muscle at the outlet of the baby's stomach has thickened, making it hard for food to pass through.
clinical_context: A common cause of vomiting in young infants; treated surgically.
common_causes: Thickening of the pyloric muscle (cause unclear)
action_note: This requires prompt paediatric surgical treatment.

simple_meaning: Brain imaging changes associated with movement disorder
patient_explanation: The scan shows changes in the brain that can be associated with a movement and coordination condition.
clinical_context: Findings vary widely; often related to injury around the time of birth.
action_note: Ongoing paediatric neurology follow-up is recommended.

simple_meaning: Early fusion of skull bones in infants
patient_explanation: One or more of the joints between the skull bones have closed earlier than usual.
clinical_context: Can affect skull shape and, if severe, may need surgical correction.
action_note: Paediatric neurosurgical evaluation is recommended.

patient_explanation: There is a growth in the kidney; this is the most common type of kidney tumour seen in young children.
clinical_context: Usually presents in early childhood; often treatable with good outcomes.
action_note: This requires urgent paediatric oncology review.

simple_meaning: Nerve tissue tumour, common in young children
patient_explanation: There is a growth arising from nerve tissue, most often found in young children.
clinical_context: Commonly arises from the adrenal gland; requires urgent oncology evaluation.
common_causes: Usually sporadic; arises from nerve tissue
action_note: This requires urgent paediatric oncology review.

patient_explanation: There are findings suggestive of a cancer that affects the lymphatic system, often seen as enlarged lymph nodes.
clinical_context: A group of cancers affecting lymphoid tissue; often treatable, especially if caught early.
action_note: This requires urgent oncology review.
follow_up: Urgent oncology referral; biopsy for confirmation

simple_meaning: Blood cancer cells affecting an organ
patient_explanation: There are findings suggesting that abnormal blood cells have infiltrated an organ.
clinical_context: Seen in some blood cancers; findings guide staging and treatment.
action_note: This requires urgent haematology/oncology review.

simple_meaning: Area that lights up on a PET scan
patient_explanation: An area was seen to be more metabolically active than expected on your PET scan.
clinical_context: Suggests increased cellular activity, which can indicate cancer, infection, or inflammation.
action_note: Further correlation with other imaging or biopsy is often needed.

simple_meaning: No cancer activity seen after treatment
patient_explanation: The scan shows no signs of remaining active cancer, which is a good sign after treatment.
clinical_context: A favorable finding on follow-up PET imaging after cancer treatment.
action_note: This is a reassuring finding after treatment.

patient_explanation: There are areas in the bones that appear to be cancer that has spread from another part of the body.
clinical_context: Common site of spread for many cancers; can weaken bone.
common_causes: Breast, prostate, lung, or other cancer spread
action_note: This requires urgent oncology review.

simple_meaning: Inflammatory condition causing small clusters of cells in organs
patient_explanation: There are findings consistent with a condition that causes small clusters of inflammatory cells, often in the lungs and lymph nodes.
clinical_context: A systemic inflammatory condition that can affect multiple organs; often needs no treatment.
synonyms_in_report: bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy consistent with sarcoidosis
action_note: Ongoing monitoring is usually recommended.

patient_explanation: There are findings consistent with a bacterial infection that commonly affects the lungs.
clinical_context: Requires prompt treatment with a course of antibiotics; can be infectious.
synonyms_in_report: cavitary upper lobe changes consistent with TB
action_note: This requires prompt treatment and follow-up.

simple_meaning: Lung changes consistent with viral pneumonia
patient_explanation: The lung pattern seen on your scan is consistent with a viral pneumonia infection.
clinical_context: A pattern that became common during the COVID-19 pandemic; correlates with clinical testing.
synonyms_in_report: peripheral ground glass opacities typical of viral pneumonia
action_note: Correlate with clinical testing and symptoms.
follow_up: Medical treatment; follow-up imaging if symptoms persist

patient_explanation: There is lung scarring related to past exposure to asbestos fibers.
clinical_context: A chronic occupational lung disease from asbestos inhalation.
synonyms_in_report: basal predominant fibrosis with pleural plaques
action_note: Ongoing respiratory follow-up and occupational history documentation is important.

simple_meaning: Lung scarring from silica dust exposure
patient_explanation: There is lung scarring related to past exposure to silica dust, often from certain occupations.
clinical_context: A chronic occupational lung disease.
synonyms_in_report: upper lobe nodularity consistent with silicosis
action_note: Ongoing respiratory follow-up and occupational history documentation is important.

simple_meaning: One side of the breathing muscle not moving normally
patient_explanation: One side of the muscle that helps you breathe is not moving as it normally should.
clinical_context: Can be caused by nerve injury or, less commonly, tumour compression.
action_note: Further evaluation of the cause may be recommended.

patient_explanation: There is a collection of infected fluid (pus) in the space around your lung.
clinical_context: A complication of pneumonia or infection; often requires drainage.
synonyms_in_report: loculated pleural collection consistent with empyema
action_note: This requires prompt treatment, often including chest drainage.

patient_explanation: There is a pocket of infection with pus forming a cavity within the lung tissue.
clinical_context: Usually related to severe infection; needs antibiotic treatment.
synonyms_in_report: cavitating lung abscess with air-fluid level
action_note: This requires prompt antibiotic treatment.

simple_meaning: Lymph fluid collection around the lung
patient_explanation: There is a collection of lymphatic fluid in the space around your lung.
clinical_context: Can occur after surgery, trauma, or from tumour blockage of lymphatic vessels.
action_note: This should be evaluated to determine the cause.

patient_explanation: A device that helps regulate your heart rhythm is visible on the scan; this is expected if you have one.
clinical_context: Not a finding of concern by itself; position and function usually checked separately.
common_causes: Prior device implantation for arrhythmia management
action_note: This should be interpreted with your device follow-up care.

simple_meaning: Heart chamber changes related to irregular rhythm
patient_explanation: The scan shows heart chamber changes that can be associated with an irregular heartbeat.
clinical_context: Often accompanies longstanding atrial fibrillation, causing chamber enlargement.
synonyms_in_report: left atrial enlargement in the setting of atrial fibrillation
action_note: Discuss this finding with a healthcare professional.

simple_meaning: Blood clot in a small pouch of the heart
patient_explanation: A blood clot has formed in a small pouch of the upper heart chamber.
clinical_context: A concerning finding that increases stroke risk, often related to atrial fibrillation.
synonyms_in_report: thrombus within the left atrial appendage
action_note: This requires urgent cardiology review.

simple_meaning: Infection of the heart valve lining
patient_explanation: There are signs of an infection affecting the inner lining of the heart, often involving a valve.
clinical_context: A serious infection requiring prompt antibiotic treatment.
synonyms_in_report: vegetation on the mitral valve consistent with endocarditis
action_note: This requires urgent treatment.

simple_meaning: Inflammation of the sac around the heart
patient_explanation: The sac surrounding the heart is inflamed.
clinical_context: Usually caused by viral infection; can cause chest pain but often resolves with treatment.
synonyms_in_report: pericardial thickening with enhancement consistent with pericarditis
action_note: Discuss this finding with a healthcare professional.

simple_meaning: Stiffened sac around the heart restricting movement
patient_explanation: The sac around your heart has become stiff and thickened, restricting how well the heart can fill.
clinical_context: A chronic condition that can impair heart function; may need surgical treatment.
synonyms_in_report: pericardial thickening and calcification consistent with constriction
action_note: This requires cardiology evaluation.

simple_meaning: Abnormal growth within or on the heart
patient_explanation: An abnormal growth has been found in or on the heart that needs further evaluation.
clinical_context: Can be benign (myxoma) or, rarely, malignant; further characterization needed.
synonyms_in_report: mobile mass attached to the atrial septum consistent with myxoma
action_note: This requires prompt cardiology/cardiac surgery evaluation.

patient_explanation: There is a collection of blood in the space around your lung.
clinical_context: Usually related to trauma; can require drainage depending on size.
synonyms_in_report: hyperdense pleural collection consistent with blood
action_note: This requires prompt medical/surgical assessment.

simple_meaning: Multiple rib fractures causing unstable chest wall
patient_explanation: Several ribs are broken in a pattern that makes part of your chest wall unstable.
clinical_context: A serious traumatic injury that can affect breathing.
action_note: This requires urgent trauma team assessment.

patient_explanation: There is a tear in the tissue of your spleen, usually from an injury.
clinical_context: Graded by severity; can cause internal bleeding requiring urgent treatment.
action_note: This requires urgent surgical assessment.

patient_explanation: There is a tear in the tissue of your liver, usually from an injury.
clinical_context: Graded by severity; can cause internal bleeding requiring urgent treatment.
action_note: This requires urgent surgical assessment.

patient_explanation: There is a tear in the tissue of your kidney, usually from an injury.
clinical_context: Graded by severity; management depends on extent of injury and bleeding.
action_note: This requires urgent urology/trauma assessment.

patient_explanation: There is evidence of injury to the brain following a head trauma.
clinical_context: Ranges from mild concussion to severe injury; findings guide management.
action_note: This requires urgent neurosurgical/neurological assessment.

patient_explanation: You have had a mild brain injury following a knock to the head; the scan itself often looks normal.
clinical_context: Usually resolves with rest; imaging is often normal despite symptoms.
action_note: Rest and gradual return to activity is usually advised.
follow_up: Follow concussion protocol; medical review if symptoms persist

simple_meaning: Thin-walled air-filled cyst in the lung
patient_explanation: There is a thin-walled, air-filled cavity in the lung, often forming after infection or trauma.
clinical_context: Usually resolves over time; monitored to ensure resolution.
action_note: Usually monitored to ensure resolution.

simple_meaning: Fat particles blocking small blood vessels
patient_explanation: Small particles of fat have entered the bloodstream and are blocking tiny blood vessels, often after a fracture.
clinical_context: A serious complication that can occur after long bone fractures.
synonyms_in_report: diffuse micronodular opacities consistent with fat embolism syndrome
action_note: This requires urgent medical treatment.

simple_meaning: Severe lung inflammation affecting oxygen levels
patient_explanation: There is widespread inflammation in both lungs that is affecting how well oxygen gets into your blood.
clinical_context: A serious condition often requiring intensive care support.
synonyms_in_report: bilateral diffuse airspace opacities consistent with ARDS
action_note: This requires urgent intensive care management.

patient_explanation: There are signs of a lung infection caused by food, liquid, or stomach contents being breathed into the lungs.
clinical_context: Common in patients with swallowing difficulties or reduced consciousness.
synonyms_in_report: dependent lower lobe consolidation consistent with aspiration
action_note: This should be treated promptly with antibiotics.
follow_up: Medical treatment; speech and swallow assessment

simple_meaning: Inhaled object stuck in the airway
patient_explanation: An object appears to have been breathed into the airway and become lodged there.
clinical_context: Common in young children; can cause airway obstruction requiring urgent removal.
synonyms_in_report: radiopaque foreign body in the right main bronchus
common_causes: Accidental inhalation of small object or food
action_note: This requires urgent removal.

simple_meaning: Object stuck in the food pipe
patient_explanation: An object appears to be lodged in the tube that carries food from your mouth to your stomach.
clinical_context: Common, especially in children; usually needs prompt removal.
synonyms_in_report: radiopaque foreign body in the mid esophagus
action_note: This requires prompt removal.

simple_meaning: Tear in the food pipe wall
patient_explanation: There is a tear in the wall of the tube that carries food from your mouth to your stomach.
clinical_context: A serious emergency that can lead to infection of the chest cavity if untreated.
action_note: This is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment.

patient_explanation: There is a hole in the wall of your intestine, which can allow contents to leak into the abdomen.
clinical_context: A surgical emergency requiring immediate treatment.
synonyms_in_report: free intraperitoneal air consistent with perforation
action_note: This is a surgical emergency requiring immediate treatment.

patient_explanation: Part of your intestine has twisted on itself, which can block blood supply and cause obstruction.
clinical_context: A surgical emergency requiring prompt treatment to prevent bowel damage.
action_note: This requires urgent surgical evaluation.

simple_meaning: Bowel tissue damaged from reduced blood flow
patient_explanation: Part of your intestine shows signs of damage from reduced blood supply.
clinical_context: A serious condition that can progress to bowel death if untreated.
synonyms_in_report: bowel wall pneumatosis consistent with ischemia
action_note: This is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment.

simple_meaning: Dangerously high pressure inside the abdomen
patient_explanation: The pressure inside your abdomen has become dangerously high, which can affect organ function.
clinical_context: A critical care emergency, often following major trauma or surgery.
synonyms_in_report: tense ascites with organ compression consistent with compartment syndrome
action_note: This is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment.

patient_explanation: There is a collection of fluid at the site of a recent surgery.
clinical_context: Common after surgery; most resolve on their own unless infected.
action_note: Usually monitored; drainage if infected or symptomatic.

simple_meaning: Leak at a surgical bowel connection
patient_explanation: There are signs of a leak at the site where two parts of the bowel were surgically joined together.
clinical_context: A serious post-surgical complication requiring prompt evaluation.
synonyms_in_report: extravasation of oral contrast at the anastomosis
action_note: This requires urgent surgical evaluation.
